poc_plan: Duration: 6 weeks (3-week canary + 3-week load/stability + rollback validation)
Week 0: infra prep - VPC peering, KMS setup, Splunk log forwarder, whitelist IPs
Canary: route 10% prod-like traffic to Dedicated pool for initial 72 hours, monitors on error rate/latency/throughput
Model variants: primary = quantized 8-bit LLM (cost-optimized), fallback = full precision 16-bit replica; automated routing by quality threshold
Fallback routing policy: on quality regression or error spike, instant fallback to hosted-models or alternate region instance; retry/backoff policy in place
Region failover test: simulate US region outage, verify automated traffic shift to EU region within 45s and health checks trigger rollback if errors > thresholds
Rollback criteria: sustained error rate > 0.5% OR p95 latency increase > 30% for 5 continuous minutes -> immediate rollback to previous variant
Success metrics: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 300ms (US), availability >= 99.5% during POC, rerank accuracy delta <= 2% vs baseline evaluation set
